content.content: 1. Necessity: the refusal needs the position rule for a position to be non-unique — without a defined position, refusing an ambiguous dependency set is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the refusal contradicts the position rule; it adds a guard and restates neither the rule nor resolution. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The refusal is where the position rule meets a forked dependency set; the gate keeps the guard sound without testing resolution itself.
